// diagnostic

E0423

`` `uninit` needs a plain-data type ``.

What

`` `uninit` needs a plain-data type ``.

Why

The named type may own heap memory or need cleanup, so leaving it uninitialized is unsafe.

Fix

use plain data — a number, `Bool`, `Char`, `U8`, or a fixed array of those (e.g. `[4096]U8`).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0423: tests/ui/uninit_bad_type.stderr.

    |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `String (text)` may own heap memory or need cleanup, so leaving it uninitialized is unsafe
 Fix: use plain data — a number, `Bool`, `Char`, `U8`, or a fixed array of those (e.g. `[4096]U8`)
